item.description:
Board AI uses fewer tokens; AI Usage page with a graph

  • Board AI no longer types "Board check" prompts into your sessions. It reads the last report from the transcript instead.
  • New Settings page "AI Usage": a bar graph of tokens with 24h / 7d / 30d / All time filters, totals (tokens, cost, calls) and a table for each source. "Clear usage history" resets it.
  • Usage (tokens and cost) in the context ring popover: Today and Since launch for Board AI, This chat for Quick AI, with a Details link to the AI Usage page.
  • The context ring always shows, also in a new chat and when Board AI is off. "Start fresh session" is removed from the popover; use New chat at the top.
  • One master Board AI switch in Settings and Command-P. When off, Board AI makes no model calls, starts no AI command-line tools, and its other switches are disabled.
  • Background model and effort pickers for Board AI side jobs (briefs, grouping, names, icons). Default: same as Board AI.
  • Automatic briefs use a short excerpt, not a fork of the whole session. The Board chat starts fresh after 100k tokens, with a handover note. New chat hides the old chat at once.
  • Limits: cost is a list-price estimate from Claude Code (not a bill on a subscription); Codex and Cursor cost may be partial and shows as "$x+". Hourly data starts with this build.
